title: Roman numeral converter
description: Converts in both directions. Give a Roman numeral string (case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace ignored) to get its decimal value, or an integer 1-3999 (or a digit string) to get its Roman numeral. Returns {valid, direction, roman, decimal, breakdown} where breakdown lists each symbol group and its value; invalid or non-canonical numerals (e.g. IIII, IC, VX, IIV) return {valid:false, error, message}.

value.description: A Roman numeral like "MCMXCIV", or an integer like 1994 (a digit-only string like "1994" is treated as a number).
